name: product-demo-studio
description: Consume a validated Product Experience handoff, independently reassess all eleven demo-worthiness criteria, and produce persuasive truthful videos or fix-oriented Product-Readiness Feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Produce killer demos or product-readiness feedback.
interface.longDescription: Consume Product Experience Engineering's current pre-video handoff, then plan, independently assess, capture, narrate, compose, render, and validate truthful product demos. Fail closed to fix-oriented Product-Readiness Feedback when the product or story cannot clear the demo-worthiness, persuasion, correctness, and evidence gates.
defaultPrompt: Assess this product and produce only demo-worthy videos.
Turn this workflow into a persuasive product demo.
Audit this demo proxy against truth, craft, and persuasion gates.
